claim_one_line: REVIEW 1 OF THE CONSOLIDATION SEAT -- the commissioned decadal review of this branch's own window (qB1024-qB1053, thirty arcs), run by the seat that produced it, with independence arriving one step later at main's digest per the commission's condition 3. THE FIVE FINDINGS, all measured with this window excluded from every denominator that measures it (E37): (1) ALL THIRTY ARCS CARRY verdict PROVED, against a corpus base rate measured over the other 930 with the strata separated (E20): instrument arcs 73/90 = 81.1%, plain arcs 538/841 = 63.97%; this window is 5 instrument (P = 0.35, NOT significant, withdrawn from the claim) plus 25 plain (P = 1.4e-5, the real finding, and the pooled 3e-6 first published here was a stratum-conflation) -- while EIGHTEEN of the thirty bodies carry retraction, refutation, decline or non-finding language and TWO declare an outright NON-FINDING; this is the window's own L166 instanced thirty times, by arcs banked AFTER L166 was written. THE CONTROL that makes it fair: the same thirty arcs carry an atlas status that DOES discriminate (banked 18, dead 9, dormant 1, open 2), so the judgement was made and recorded, just not in the field the negatives hunts select on -- a routing failure between two metadata fields, not an absence of judgement. (2) A HEADLINE FINDING OF THIS REVIEW WAS RETRACTED BY THE REVIEW ITSELF, and the retraction is the more useful result. The first form read: the consolidation-debt metric (published 245 -> 175) SELECTS ON verdict == PROVED, counts 175 and is blind to 191, showing 48% of its own subject -- framed as L166's defect committed by the window's own metric. THAT FRAMING DOES NOT SURVIVE CHECKING. The scope is DECLARED, in DEBT_LEDGER itself, in a comparison table added by qB1033 -- an arc of this same window: REPRESENTATION_TRIAGE covers PROVED u NEGATIVE, this ledger covers PROVED, and the two 'differ, and each is right for its own question'. The code agrees rather than merely the prose (representation_sweep.py:69 rejects any verdict outside PROVED/NEGATIVE), and that register is GATED -- representation-sweep fails the build on an untriaged arc -- so the 191 arcs called invisible are covered by a STRONGER mechanism than the ungated ledger they were measured against. The error was one of SCOPE, not arithmetic: the numbers were right and the sentence around them was wrong, which is exactly the defect species this window spent thirty arcs cataloguing, committed by the review that catalogued it. WHAT SURVIVES is a PARTITION REMAINDER an order of magnitude smaller: the two registers divide the corpus by verdict and NEITHER TAKES OPEN OR RETRACTED -- 41 arcs corpus-wide (OPEN 31, RETRACTED 10), of which 20 are uncited on the five curated surfaces and are not instruments (OPEN 16, RETRACTED 4); the four uncited RETRACTED are the least defensible cell. WHY IT HAPPENED, recorded because a taxonomy that only catalogues other people's instances is untested: I read the metric's CODE and the ledger's ROWS and did not read the section of that same file, twenty lines above the rows, which declares the scope -- triaging a document by the part that answered my question. (3) THE HANDOFF'S OWN CORRECTION TALLY DOES NOT SUM -- 12+6+4+1 = 23 against 24 numbered rows, and section 2.2's eleven rows carry no catch-mechanism column so the partition is not derivable from the tables it summarises; B1052 gated that section with n_corr >= 20, a lower bound standing in for an exact four-way claim, which is the text-versus-structure species inside the instrument built to prevent it. (4) TWENTY-NINE OF THIRTY ARCS ARE UNSEALED AND TWO DECLARE IT, against main's R43/R44 standard of declaring every unsealed arc in its header; the practice is defensible for consolidation arcs, the declaration is not optional. (5) TEMPLATE ITEM 1b's OWN INSTRUMENT UNDER-REPORTS: git branch -r --no-merged returned one ref on this container while git ls-remote --heads returns three, missing the relay audit seat's LIVE branch -- the command answers from the clone's cache, not from the remote. ADVANCEMENT, the window's better half: 27 LAW_MAP rows split 12 restorations / 4 re-verifications / 11 new, restorations largest, each re-verified before restoration per campaign step 5 -- a consolidation, not a discovery window -- but all 27 landed in section A (the object's arithmetic) and at least SEVEN state programme methodology, for which LAW_MAP has no section at all (section D's meta-laws are object/observer physics), a structural gap and an owner's call. THE LOOP: the last parseable action-items block on this branch is Review 37 and R38-R42 carry none, but main resumed at R43/R44 AFTER the fork, so the gap is BRANCH-LOCAL -- correcting the commission's reading that no prior review existed; the one inherited item is TOOLBOX.md, which R42 escalated at lag 638 as 'TWO reviews old' with 'it does not survive a third review undeclared', now at lag 684, and this review is the third and declares rather than discharges it because the document is main's and this branch never merges -- the routing is the defect, not the diligence. PROVENANCE, WITH A CORRECTION AGAINST THIS ARC'S OWN FIRST DRAFT: it reported '29 reproducers re-executed, 29 pass, 0 fail' and graded them RUN -- measured by EXIT CODE, and 28 of the 30 scripts return 0 whether they pass or fail, so that sweep was reading a harness that cannot fail. The honest instrument is scripts/checks/instrument_freshness.py, which reads each arc's own recorded verdict and separates STALE-GREEN / RED / KEY-LOSS / CRASH; it reports 28 instruments re-run, all green. B1025 carries no reproducer and declares it. PROMOTION SWEEP: zero promotions to CLAIMS.md, the firewall held; its two window citations are correction banners, not promotions. Sixteen action items registered with owners split OWNER / SEAT / MAIN-DIGEST; the twelve leads qL155-qL166 are registered and deliberately NOT decided, per the commission. NOT-REACHED, countable and never an implied rejection: the Codeberg mirror inventory, main's own B1025-B1044, the other 931 arcs, TOOLBOX.md's content, the twelve leads' dispositions. 72 mechanical checks; nothing to CLAIMS.md; Gate 5 untouched; no mathematics asserted or disturbed.
